findings.message:
**Wrong Default**

`readonly` defaults to `true`, so every editor session starts in read-only mode even though the feature is not implemented. The `-R` flag is meant to opt into read-only mode, but with this default the flag is a no-op and normal editing is effectively disabled by default. The default should be `false`.

**Silent File Drop**

When multiple file arguments are passed, only `files[0]` is opened and the rest are silently ignored. A user running `sodium a.txt b.txt` will believe both files are open. At minimum, warn about unsupported extra files rather than dropping them silently.
